responsibility: Formats type-comparison failures into user-facing descriptions and provides helpers for rendering types in diagnostic-friendly long or shortened forms, including path trimming and spill-to-disk support for very long names.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the crate-root `error.rs`, which defines diagnostic structs to be emitted, and `mir/interpret/error.rs`, which models runtime-like failures during MIR interpretation, this file is specifically about rendering type errors and types into human-readable diagnostic text, including shortening and spill-to-disk for very long names.
